<div class="hero-title" style="font-size: 2.2rem; margin-bottom: 0.5rem; font-weight: 700;">CINAS Multi-Sector Data Lake</div>
<div class="hero-subtitle" style="font-size: 1.15rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; color: #495057;">Data Infrastructure for Artificial Intelligence, Epidemiology, and Public Policy</div>

The **CINAS Data Lake** consolidates an integrated public data infrastructure at the national level in Brazil. Designed to overcome the historical fragmentation of health and social determinants data, the ecosystem supports multidisciplinary research in Artificial Intelligence, spatial epidemiology, nuclear medicine, health technology assessment, and predictive modeling for the public healthcare system (SUS).

The platform adopts modern data engineering practices and layered architecture, performing curation, semantic harmonization, and analytical standardization of hundreds of millions of public records with high performance and scientific rigor.
:::

## Strategic Axes & Integrated Providers {.mb-4}

The platform transcends isolated hospital analytics by articulating data across **seven key national axes**:

::: {.grid .mb-5}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa hospital >}} DATASUS
**Brazilian Ministry of Health (SUS)**
* **Hospital Inpatients (SIHSUS):** Care production and hospital clinical outcomes across Brazil.
* **Outpatient Care (SIASUS):** Specialized procedures, diagnostic exams, and psychosocial care.
* **Epidemiological Surveillance (SINAN):** Compulsory reporting of infectious diseases and public health events.
* **Healthcare Facilities (CNES):** National registry of hospitals, clinics, beds, and health teams.
* **Vital Statistics:** Historical series of mortality (SIM) and live births (SINASC).
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa cloud-sun >}} INMET
**National Institute of Meteorology**
* **Continuous Historical Records:** Tens of millions of continuous hourly weather measurements since 2008.
* **Station Network:** Continuous monitoring across hundreds of automatic and conventional weather stations.
* **Environmental Variables:** Temperature, relative humidity, precipitation, solar radiation, and atmospheric pressure.
* **Health Impacts:** Statistical modeling of climate extremes and temperature variations on morbimortality.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa users >}} IBGE & Demographics
**Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics**
* **2022 Demographic Census:** Audited data on population, households, and territory for all 5,570 municipalities.
* **Census Tract Geography:** Detailed spatial mapping across hundreds of thousands of census sectors.
* **Historical Series & Projections:** Intercensal annual population estimates and long-term demographic projections.
* **Epidemiological Denominators:** Solid foundation for calculating standardized incidence and mortality rates.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa shield-halved >}} ANS (Private Healthcare)
**National Supplementary Health Agency**
* **Comprehensive Healthcare View:** Sector insights for more than 50 million beneficiaries in private healthcare.
* **Active Health Plans (CADOP):** Complete registry of operators, coverage modalities, and market segments.
* **Beneficiaries (SIB):** Medical and dental plan beneficiaries aggregated by age bracket, sex, and geographic region.
* **Financial & Claims Data (DIOPS):** Accounting monitoring, operational revenues, and healthcare assistance claims.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa pills >}} CMED & ANVISA
**Pharmaceutical Market Regulation**
* **Pharmacoeconomics Catalog:** Standardized commercial pharmaceutical presentations registered in Brazil.
* **Price Ceilings:** Regulatory factory prices (PF) and maximum consumer prices (PMC) by state.
* **Public Procurement:** Price adequacy coefficients (CAP) and rules for governmental health acquisitions.
* **Access Research:** Cost-effectiveness and budgetary impact assessments for new clinical therapies.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-6 .g-col-lg-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa scale-balanced >}} IPEA & UNDP
**Social Vulnerability & Human Development**
* **Social Vulnerability Atlas (IVS):** Indicators covering urban infrastructure, human capital, and income.
* **Municipal Human Development Atlas (IDHM):** Longevity, education, and municipal income dimensions.
* **Social Determinants:** Control of socioeconomic inequalities in clinical trials and epidemiological studies.
* **Regional Detail:** Comprehensive coverage of all 645 municipalities in São Paulo state and national coverage.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-12}
::: {.card .h-100 .shadow-sm .border-0 .p-3}
### {{< fa coins >}} SIOPS (Public Health Budgets)
**Brazilian Ministry of Health**
Tracking of municipal and state public health budgets and constitutional expenditures in Public Health Actions and Services (ASPS), correlating public investment capacity with health outcomes and regional infrastructure.
:::
:::

:::

## Platform Pillars & Scientific Governance {.mb-4}

::: {.grid .mb-5}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .border-0 .shadow-sm .p-3}
#### {{< fa layers-group >}} Layered Architecture
Structured processing from raw data ingestion to refined analytical representations, ensuring provenance integrity and query performance for advanced AI models.
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .border-0 .shadow-sm .p-3}
#### {{< fa network-wired >}} Semantic Interoperability
Cross-domain standardization using universal codes: IBGE geocodes, International Classification of Diseases (ICD-10), SUS unified procedure codes (SIGTAP), and health occupations (CBO).
:::
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-4}
::: {.card .h-100 .border-0 .shadow-sm .p-3}
#### {{< fa check-double >}} Traceability & Reproducibility
Continuous auditing of data lineage and temporal integrity, ensuring that scientific experiments, academic papers, and technical reports can be reproduced with full reliability.
:::
:::

:::
